newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi prince to buy the Paris George V hotel.
newsitem.headline: Saudi prince to buy the Paris George V hotel.

text.p: Saudi Prince al-Waleed bin Talal said on Wednesday he had agreed to buy the Hotel George V in Paris from Granada Group Plc for $172 million.
A statement from the prince's office in Riyadh said the transaction would be completed following the meeting of the Workers Committee of the Hotel George V which had been called for Wednesday.
"The Hotel George V is one of the most famous hotels in Europe and we believe it has the potential to become one of the most successful hotels in the world," Prince al-Waleed said in the statement.
The 258-room luxury hotel, which opened in 1928, is in the heart of Paris's most fashionable district and is a favourite among celebrities and dignitaries.

The billionaire prince, a grandson of the founder of Saudi Arabia King Abdul-Aziz al-Saud, already has substantial investments in Citicorp, Euro Disney, Canary Wharf in London's Docklands, U.S. retail group Saks Fifth Avenue, the Plaza Hotel in New York and the Four Seasons and Fairmont Hotel chains.
He has also set up an entertainment business with U.S. popstar Michael Jackson.
